// MattSkills 像素卡域(工单 04):PixelCards 色表/档位/对比度罩纱与容器三态的移植,纯函数。
// 真源:port-notes/pixel-cards.md(上游 PixelCardTheme.ts / PixelCardBtns.ts)与
// port-notes/kernel-domain.md(上游 container-view.ts)、action-prompts.md(上游 row-actions.ts)。
// 双态加载:build 时原样拼进 bundle-0.txt(纯脚本,IIFE 挂 globalThis);Node 测试直接 import
// 执行同一 IIFE。无 DOM 依赖——渲染在 app.js,这里只出数据与判定。
"use strict";
(function (global) {
  // 动作色表(pixel-cards.md §1):hex 一律无 # 前缀;map 是 cardColorOf 的兜底色。
  var CARD_ACTION_COLORS = {
    diagnose: "fbca04",
    fix: "d73a4a",
    execute: "10b981",
    claim: "b60205",
    supplement: "5319e7",
    research: "0ea5e9",
    grill: "9d7cd8",
    proto: "f59e0b",
    map: "8b5cf6",
    block: "a3231a",
  };

  // 档位样式(pixel-cards.md §2):colorKey 先查页面标签色表;colorKey 都 miss 才落动作色表。
  // hollow=false 实心编号徽章(底=主色,字=cardInkOn);true 描线款(边=主色,墨字)。
  // icon 是 PixelCardBtns 的 ICB 内联 SVG 名(chat/play/search/hammer/proto),M1 行内不画按钮,留档对齐。
  var CARD_ACTION_STYLE = {
    diagnose: { colorKey: "needs-triage", icon: "chat", hollow: false },
    fix: { colorKey: "bug", icon: "hammer", hollow: false },
    execute: { colorKey: "wayfinder:task", icon: "play", hollow: false },
    claim: { colorKey: "ready-for-human", icon: "play", hollow: false },
    supplement: { colorKey: "needs-info", icon: "play", hollow: false },
    research: { colorKey: "wayfinder:research", icon: "search", hollow: true },
    grill: { colorKey: "wayfinder:grilling", icon: "chat", hollow: true },
    proto: { colorKey: "wayfinder:prototype", icon: "proto", hollow: true },
    implement: { colorKey: "implement", icon: "hammer", hollow: false },
  };

  // 容器身份色(kernel-domain.md §6,上游 container-view.ts 唯一真源)。
  var CONTAINER_ACCENT = { map: "#c084fc", spec: "#1D4ED8" };
  var CONTAINER_TINT = { map: "rgba(188,140,255,.07)", spec: "rgba(29,78,216,.10)" };
  var CONTAINER_CHIP_CLASS = { map: "dsws-chip-m", spec: "dsws-chip-s" };
  var CONTAINER_CHIP_LABEL = { map: "地图", spec: "规格" }; // 上游 list.mapChip / list.specChip
  var CONTAINER_EMPTY_COLOR = "#f59e0b";
  var CONTAINER_DONE_COLOR = "#3fb950";

  // ---- 对比度罩纱(PixelCardTheme.ts):#1c1004 深墨与 #fff9ec 米白二选一,双阈值标记浅色罩纱带 ----
  function lumChan(x) {
    x /= 255;
    return x <= 0.03928 ? x / 12.92 : Math.pow((x + 0.055) / 1.055, 2.4);
  }
  function cardLum(hex) {
    var h = String(hex === null || hex === undefined ? "" : hex).replace(/^#/, "");
    if (!/^[0-9a-fA-F]{6}$/.test(h)) return 0;
    return (
      0.2126 * lumChan(parseInt(h.slice(0, 2), 16)) +
      0.7152 * lumChan(parseInt(h.slice(2, 4), 16)) +
      0.0722 * lumChan(parseInt(h.slice(4, 6), 16))
    );
  }
  function cardInkOn(hex) {
    var l = cardLum(hex);
    return (l + 0.05) / 0.05 >= 1.05 / (l + 0.05) ? "#1c1004" : "#fff9ec";
  }
  function cardBoostOn(hex) {
    var l = cardLum(hex);
    var wOk = 1.05 / (l + 0.05) >= 4.6; // 白字达标(留 4.6 余量而非 4.5)
    var dOk = (l + 0.05) / (cardLum("1c1004") + 0.05) >= 4.5; // 深字达标
    return !wOk && !dOk; // 两种字都不达标 → 浅色主题加深墨罩纱(元素标 data-cd-boost="1")
  }

  /** 主色:先查页面标签色表(colorOf),miss 落档位兜底色,再 miss 回地图紫;去 # 转小写。 */
  function cardColorOf(colorKey, colorOf, actionKey) {
    var c = colorOf && colorOf[colorKey];
    if (!c && actionKey) c = CARD_ACTION_COLORS[actionKey];
    return String(c === null || c === undefined ? "" : c).replace(/^#/, "").toLowerCase() || "8b5cf6";
  }

  // ---- 档位判定(action-prompts.md rowActionKind 十档阶梯:状态优先于类型,标签按 name) ----
  function labelSet(row) {
    var out = {};
    var ls = row && Array.isArray(row.labels) ? row.labels : [];
    for (var i = 0; i < ls.length; i++) {
      if (ls[i] && ls[i].name) out[String(ls[i].name)] = true;
    }
    return out;
  }
  function rowActionKind(row) {
    var has = labelSet(row);
    var n = 0;
    for (var k in has) n++;
    if (n === 0 || has["needs-triage"]) return "diagnose"; // 无标签或 needs-triage → 诊断
    if (has["ready-for-human"]) return "claim"; // 接手优先于修复(两枚同现取接手)
    if (has["needs-info"]) return "supplement";
    if (has.bug) return "fix";
    if (has["wayfinder:grilling"]) return "grill";
    if (has["wayfinder:research"]) return "research";
    if (has["wayfinder:prototype"]) return "proto";
    if (has["wayfinder:task"]) return "execute";
    if (has["ready-for-agent"]) return "implement";
    return "execute"; // 兜底执行
  }

  // ---- 容器三态(kernel-domain.md §6):stats 缺失或 total=0 → empty;closed===total → done ----
  function containerStateOf(stats) {
    var total = stats && typeof stats.total === "number" ? stats.total : 0;
    var closed = stats && typeof stats.closed === "number" ? stats.closed : 0;
    if (total <= 0) return "empty";
    if (closed >= total) return "done";
    return "open";
  }
  /** 容器编号徽章色:done→绿 / empty→橙 / open:spec 贵族蓝、map 走 map 紫。 */
  function containerNumberColor(kind, state) {
    if (state === "done") return CONTAINER_DONE_COLOR;
    if (state === "empty") return CONTAINER_EMPTY_COLOR;
    return kind === "spec" ? CONTAINER_ACCENT.spec : "#" + CARD_ACTION_COLORS.map;
  }

  // ---- 视图投影(工单 04):状态分桶/占用口径/标签 OR/三段排序/标签目录与点击记忆 ----
  function openBlockerCountOf(row) {
    if (!Array.isArray(row.blockedBy)) return 0;
    var n = 0;
    for (var i = 0; i < row.blockedBy.length; i++) {
      var r = row.blockedBy[i];
      if (!r || r.state !== "closed") n++; // 断链(无目标)按安全阻塞计
    }
    return n;
  }
  /** 占用口径(list-page.md:blocked 筛选 = isOccupied):open 且(有认领人 或 被 open 阻塞)。 */
  function isOccupiedRow(row) {
    if (row.state === "closed") return false;
    if (Array.isArray(row.assignees) && row.assignees.length > 0) return true;
    return openBlockerCountOf(row) > 0;
  }
  /** 标签 OR 过滤:命中任一选中标签即显示;无标签行只在选了 needs-triage 时显示。容器行由调用方豁免。 */
  function labelMatches(row, labels) {
    if (!labels || labels.length === 0) return true;
    var names = [];
    var ls = Array.isArray(row.labels) ? row.labels : [];
    for (var i = 0; i < ls.length; i++) if (ls[i] && ls[i].name) names.push(String(ls[i].name));
    for (var j = 0; j < labels.length; j++) {
      if (names.indexOf(labels[j]) >= 0) return true;
      if (labels[j] === "needs-triage" && names.length === 0) return true;
    }
    return false;
  }
  /**
   * 状态视图投影:list-page.md 口径。
   *   all/open → openRows(容器行 + open 票,容器不受标签筛),closed 票进 closedRows;
   *   blocked  → openRows = 占用票(容器不进);frontier → 非占用票;
   *   closed   → 只给 closedRows,openRows 恒空。
   */
  function applyView(rows, sel) {
    var labels = (sel && sel.labels) || [];
    var state = (sel && sel.state) || "all";
    var openRows = [];
    var closedRows = [];
    for (var i = 0; i < rows.length; i++) {
      var row = rows[i];
      var isContainer = row.type === "map" || row.type === "spec";
      if (state === "closed") {
        if (!isContainer && row.state === "closed" && labelMatches(row, labels)) closedRows.push(row);
        continue;
      }
      if (isContainer) {
        if (state === "all" || state === "open") openRows.push(row); // 容器行不受标签筛
        continue;
      }
      if (row.state === "closed") {
        if (labelMatches(row, labels)) closedRows.push(row);
        continue;
      }
      if (state === "blocked" && !isOccupiedRow(row)) continue;
      if (state === "frontier" && isOccupiedRow(row)) continue;
      if (!labelMatches(row, labels)) continue;
      openRows.push(row);
    }
    return { openRows: openRows, closedRows: closedRows };
  }

  function rowKeyNumOf(row) {
    var m = /(\d+)\s*$/.exec(String(row.key || ""));
    return m ? parseInt(m[1], 10) : 0;
  }
  /** 三段排序:容器段序固定(map→spec,组间不比较键),组内按 sortKey × dir;同键兜底 effort → 编号升序。 */
  function sortViewRows(rows, sortKey, dir) {
    var d = dir === -1 ? -1 : 1;
    var rank = { map: 0, spec: 1 };
    var cmp = function (a, b) {
      var va;
      var vb;
      if (sortKey === "title") {
        va = String(a.title || "").toLowerCase();
        vb = String(b.title || "").toLowerCase();
        if (va !== vb) return va.localeCompare(vb) * d;
      } else if (sortKey === "updatedAt" || sortKey === "createdAt") {
        va = String(a[sortKey] || "");
        vb = String(b[sortKey] || "");
        if (va !== vb) return (va < vb ? -1 : 1) * d; // ISO 串字典序即时间序
      } else {
        va = rowKeyNumOf(a);
        vb = rowKeyNumOf(b);
        if (va !== vb) return (va - vb) * d;
      }
      var e = String(a.effortId || "").localeCompare(String(b.effortId || ""));
      if (e) return e;
      return rowKeyNumOf(a) - rowKeyNumOf(b);
    };
    return rows.slice().sort(function (a, b) {
      var ka = rank[a.type] ?? 2;
      var kb = rank[b.type] ?? 2;
      if (ka !== kb) return ka - kb;
      return cmp(a, b);
    });
  }

  /** 标签目录:全量行(含 closed)的标签频次表(Map name→count)。 */
  function labelCatalog(rows) {
    var cat = new Map();
    for (var i = 0; i < rows.length; i++) {
      var ls = Array.isArray(rows[i].labels) ? rows[i].labels : [];
      for (var j = 0; j < ls.length; j++) {
        if (!ls[j] || !ls[j].name) continue;
        var n = String(ls[j].name);
        cat.set(n, (cat.get(n) || 0) + 1);
      }
    }
    return cat;
  }
  /** 标签 chips 排序(list-page.md 点击记忆四键):次数降序 → 最近点击降序 → 频次降序 → 名称序。 */
  function sortLabelChips(cat, clicks) {
    var entries = [];
    cat.forEach(function (count, name) {
      entries.push({ name: name, count: count });
    });
    var c = clicks || {};
    return entries.sort(function (a, b) {
      var an = (c[a.name] && c[a.name].n) || 0;
      var bn = (c[b.name] && c[b.name].n) || 0;
      if (an !== bn) return bn - an;
      var at = (c[a.name] && c[a.name].ts) || 0;
      var bt = (c[b.name] && c[b.name].ts) || 0;
      if (at !== bt) return bt - at;
      if (a.count !== b.count) return b.count - a.count;
      return a.name.localeCompare(b.name);
    });
  }

  // ---- 墨块色值小工具(list-page.md chips):hex → alpha 底 / darken 边 ----
  function hexA(hex, a) {
    var h = String(hex === null || hex === undefined ? "" : hex).replace(/^#/, "");
    if (!/^[0-9a-fA-F]{6}$/.test(h)) return "rgba(188,140,255," + a + ")";
    return (
      "rgba(" + parseInt(h.slice(0, 2), 16) + "," + parseInt(h.slice(2, 4), 16) + "," +
      parseInt(h.slice(4, 6), 16) + "," + a + ")"
    );
  }
  function darkenHex(hex, amt) {
    var h = String(hex === null || hex === undefined ? "" : hex).replace(/^#/, "");
    if (!/^[0-9a-fA-F]{6}$/.test(h)) return "#bc8cff";
    var out = "#";
    for (var i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
      var v = Math.round(parseInt(h.slice(i * 2, i * 2 + 2), 16) * (1 - amt));
      out += (v < 16 ? "0" : "") + v.toString(16);
    }
    return out;
  }

  global.MattSkillsCards = Object.freeze({
    CARD_ACTION_COLORS: CARD_ACTION_COLORS,
    CARD_ACTION_STYLE: CARD_ACTION_STYLE,
    CONTAINER_ACCENT: CONTAINER_ACCENT,
    CONTAINER_TINT: CONTAINER_TINT,
    CONTAINER_CHIP_CLASS: CONTAINER_CHIP_CLASS,
    CONTAINER_CHIP_LABEL: CONTAINER_CHIP_LABEL,
    CONTAINER_EMPTY_COLOR: CONTAINER_EMPTY_COLOR,
    CONTAINER_DONE_COLOR: CONTAINER_DONE_COLOR,
    cardLum: cardLum,
    cardInkOn: cardInkOn,
    cardBoostOn: cardBoostOn,
    cardColorOf: cardColorOf,
    rowActionKind: rowActionKind,
    containerStateOf: containerStateOf,
    containerNumberColor: containerNumberColor,
    applyView: applyView,
    sortViewRows: sortViewRows,
    labelCatalog: labelCatalog,
    sortLabelChips: sortLabelChips,
    isOccupiedRow: isOccupiedRow,
    openBlockerCountOf: openBlockerCountOf,
    hexA: hexA,
    darkenHex: darkenHex,
  });
})(typeof globalThis !== "undefined" ? globalThis : undefined);

// MattSkills 面板应用(bundle-0.txt 的源):列表 tracer 的渲染与桥调用。
// 纯脚本无 import(资源通道只搬文本,拼接后以 <script> 注入执行),经 window.MattSkillsPanel.boot
// 交给引导页/测试架驱动。对宿主只有两个依赖:client(ext-apps 桥)与 doc(DOM)。
// 类名命名空间 ms-(M1 基础卡面;完整 PixelCards 色卡体系是工单 04,届时换 cd- 体系)。
"use strict";
(function () {
  // ---- 文案(M1 中文内联,键名按上游 copy 词表组织,为 M3 配置化留缝) ----
  var COPY = {
    loading: "正在加载看板…",
    loadFail: "看板加载失败",
    emptyTitle: "还没有工单",
    emptyBody0: "此工作区还没有 .scratch/ 工单目录。运行 ",
    emptySetup: "/setup-matt-pocock-skills",
    emptyMid: " 初始化,或让 agent 用 ",
    emptyTickets: "/to-tickets",
    emptyEnd: " 拆解规格。",
    emptyHint: "生成工单后,本页签会展示任务看板。",
    boardTitle: "任务看板",
    stateOpen: "在办",
    stateClosed: "已关闭",
    markClaimed: "已认领",
    markBlocked: "被阻塞",
    // cards.yaml 中文键(card.*):结案章/认领后缀/阻塞脚注/角标与容器 chip
    cardClosedSeal: "结案",
    cardBlockedBy: "被 {n} 挡住",
    cardBug: "BUG",
    cardDoing: "在办",
    cardPickReady: "可接",
    // 筛选行与折叠(list 词表中文内联)
    filterAll: "全部",
    filterOpen: "进行中",
    filterClosed: "已关闭",
    filterBlocked: "被阻塞",
    filterFrontier: "可接",
    sortUpdatedAt: "更新时间",
    sortCreatedAt: "创建时间",
    sortNumber: "编号",
    sortTitle: "标题",
    filterLabelAll: "全部",
    filterCollapse: "收起",
    listNone: "没有匹配的工单",
    listClosedN: "已关闭 ({n})",
  };

  // 九条计数口径:顺序即胶囊条从左到右;前三枚带 KPI 色值(list-page.md KPI 行:
  // 可接 #4ade80 / 占用 #f0883e / 已关闭 #52525b)。
  var PILLS = [
    { key: "frontier", label: "可接", color: "#4ade80" },
    { key: "open", label: "进行中" },
    { key: "occupied", label: "占用", color: "#f0883e" },
    { key: "claimed", label: "已认领" },
    { key: "blocked", label: "被阻塞" },
    { key: "bug", label: "故障" },
    { key: "triage", label: "诊断" },
    { key: "closed", label: "已关闭", color: "#52525b" },
    { key: "total", label: "全部" },
  ];

  // 内置默认标签色表(上游 src/tracker/rooms/markdown/index.ts defaultLabelPalette 的直拷,
  // 全仓唯一出处;票面既不在色表也没有自带色时回灰 cccccc)。
  var LABEL_COLORS = {
    "bug": "d73a4a",
    "needs-triage": "fbca04",
    "needs-info": "5319e7",
    "ready-for-agent": "0e8a16",
    "ready-for-human": "b60205",
    "wontfix": "ffffff",
    "wayfinder:map": "8b5cf6",
    "wayfinder:research": "0ea5e9",
    "wayfinder:prototype": "f59e0b",
    "wayfinder:grilling": "9d7cd8",
    "wayfinder:task": "10b981",
  };
  function labelColorOf(name) {
    return LABEL_COLORS[name] || "cccccc";
  }

  // PixelCards 域(工单 04,src/ui/cards.mjs;拼接进 bundle 后挂 globalThis)。
  var Cards = globalThis.MattSkillsCards || {};
  // 页面 colorOf 表:标签配置色 + implement 档塞规格身份色(pixel-cards.md §1)。
  var COLOR_OF = Object.assign({}, LABEL_COLORS, { implement: Cards.CONTAINER_ACCENT ? Cards.CONTAINER_ACCENT.spec.slice(1) : "1D4ED8" });

  // ---- 小工具 ----
  function el(doc, tag, cls, text) {
    var n = doc.createElement(tag);
    if (cls) n.className = cls;
    if (text !== undefined && text !== null) n.textContent = String(text);
    return n;
  }
  function textOf(res) {
    if (res && Array.isArray(res.content)) {
      for (var c of res.content) if (c && c.type === "text" && c.text) return c.text;
    }
    return "";
  }
  /** 卡的显示编号:#effort/编号(根级无目录前缀);退化身份的 key 已带目录前缀,不重复拼。 */
  function numberText(row) {
    var key = String(row.key || "");
    if (key.includes("/")) return "#" + key;
    return "#" + (row.effortId ? row.effortId + "/" : "") + key;
  }
  /** 组内排序主键:编号尾数字(退化身份取文件名段里的数字,取不到按 0)。 */
  function numOf(row) {
    var m = /(\d+)\s*$/.exec(String(row.key || ""));
    return m ? parseInt(m[1], 10) : 0;
  }
  /** 三段排序(list-page.md):探索地图 → 规格 → 普通票;组内编号升序,标题/目录兜底。 */
  function sortRows(rows) {
    var rank = { map: 0, spec: 1 };
    return rows.slice().sort(function (a, b) {
      var ka = rank[a.type] ?? 2;
      var kb = rank[b.type] ?? 2;
      if (ka !== kb) return ka - kb;
      var d = numOf(a) - numOf(b);
      if (d) return d;
      d = String(a.title || "").localeCompare(String(b.title || ""));
      if (d) return d;
      return String(a.effortId || "").localeCompare(String(b.effortId || ""));
    });
  }
  /** 占用口径(与 computeCounts 同义):被 open 阻塞(断链按安全阻塞)。 */
  function isBlocked(row) {
    return Array.isArray(row.blockedBy) && row.blockedBy.some(function (r) {
      return !r || r.state !== "closed";
    });
  }
  function isClaimed(row) {
    return Array.isArray(row.assignees) && row.assignees.length > 0;
  }

  // ---- 状态视图 ----
  function renderLoading(doc, root) {
    var app = el(doc, "div", "ms-app");
    app.append(el(doc, "div", "ms-state ms-loading", COPY.loading));
    root.replaceChildren(app);
  }
  function renderError(doc, root, err) {
    var app = el(doc, "div", "ms-app");
    var box = el(doc, "div", "ms-state ms-error");
    box.append(el(doc, "div", "ms-error-title", COPY.loadFail));
    box.append(el(doc, "div", "ms-error-detail", (err && err.message) || String(err)));
    app.append(box);
    root.replaceChildren(app);
  }
  /** 空工作区引导态(延续骨架期文案,指向建卡技能,绝不回演示数据)。 */
  function renderGuide(doc, root) {
    var app = el(doc, "div", "ms-app");
    var box = el(doc, "div", "ms-state ms-empty");
    box.append(el(doc, "h1", "ms-empty-title", COPY.emptyTitle));
    var p = el(doc, "p", "ms-empty-body");
    p.append(COPY.emptyBody0);
    p.append(el(doc, "code", null, COPY.emptySetup));
    p.append(COPY.emptyMid);
    p.append(el(doc, "code", null, COPY.emptyTickets));
    p.append(COPY.emptyEnd);
    box.append(p);
    box.append(el(doc, "p", "ms-empty-hint", COPY.emptyHint));
    app.append(box);
    root.replaceChildren(app);
  }

  // ---- 计数胶囊条 + 卡片行 ----
  function renderCountsBar(doc, counts) {
    var bar = el(doc, "div", "ms-counts");
    for (var p of PILLS) {
      var pill = el(doc, "span", "ms-pill" + (p.color ? " ms-kpi" : ""), p.label + " " + (counts[p.key] ?? 0));
      pill.setAttribute("data-key", p.key);
      if (p.color) {
        pill.setAttribute("data-color", p.color);
        pill.style.color = p.color;
        pill.style.borderColor = p.color;
      }
      bar.append(pill);
    }
    return bar;
  }
  /** open 阻塞者数(断链按安全阻塞计,与 isBlocked 同口径)。 */
  function openBlockerCount(row) {
    if (!Array.isArray(row.blockedBy)) return 0;
    return row.blockedBy.filter(function (r) {
      return !r || r.state !== "closed";
    }).length;
  }
  /** 容器子票统计:同工作单元的票行 → {total, closed}(container-view 三态的输入)。 */
  function containerStatsOf(rows) {
    var stats = {};
    for (var row of rows) {
      if (row.type !== "map" && row.type !== "spec") continue;
      var s = stats[row.effortId] || (stats[row.effortId] = { total: 0, closed: 0 });
      for (var t of rows) {
        if (t.effortId === row.effortId && t.type !== "map" && t.type !== "spec") {
          s.total++;
          if (t.state === "closed") s.closed++;
        }
      }
    }
    return stats;
  }

  /** 票行动作主色:档位 → colorOf 表 → 档位兜底色。 */
  function actionHexOf(row) {
    var action = Cards.rowActionKind ? Cards.rowActionKind(row) : "execute";
    var style = (Cards.CARD_ACTION_STYLE || {})[action] || {};
    return Cards.cardColorOf ? Cards.cardColorOf(style.colorKey, COLOR_OF, action) : "8b5cf6";
  }

  /** 编号徽章(PixelCardNo):实心档底=主色、字=cardInkOn、罩纱带挂标记;描线档边=主色。 */
  function appendBadge(doc, host, row, hex) {
    var style = (Cards.CARD_ACTION_STYLE || {})[Cards.rowActionKind ? Cards.rowActionKind(row) : ""] || {};
    var badge = el(doc, "span", "ms-num cd-no");
    badge.textContent = numberText(row);
    badge.setAttribute("title", numberText(row));
    if (style.hollow) {
      badge.className += " cd-nonum line";
      badge.style.borderColor = "#" + hex;
    } else {
      badge.style.background = "#" + hex;
      badge.style.color = Cards.cardInkOn ? Cards.cardInkOn(hex) : "#1c1004";
      if (Cards.cardBoostOn && Cards.cardBoostOn(hex)) badge.setAttribute("data-cd-boost", "1");
    }
    host.append(badge);
    return badge;
  }

  /** 容器角标:身份色 chip(地图/规格);票行状态角标:BUG 三角 / 在办 / 可接。 */
  function appendCornerMark(doc, host, row, occupied) {
    if (row.type === "map" || row.type === "spec") {
      var chip = el(doc, "span", "dsws-chip dsws-chip-container " + ((Cards.CONTAINER_CHIP_CLASS || {})[row.type] || ""));
      chip.textContent = (Cards.CONTAINER_CHIP_LABEL || {})[row.type] || "";
      chip.style.color = (Cards.CONTAINER_ACCENT || {})[row.type] || "";
      host.append(chip);
      return;
    }
    var hasBug = (row.labels || []).some(function (l) {
      return l && l.name === "bug";
    });
    if (row.state === "closed") {
      // closed 票无状态角标(bug 除外)
      if (hasBug) {
        var bugC = el(doc, "span", "cd-corner", COPY.cardBug);
        bugC.style.color = "#d73a4a"; // --cd-mark-bug
        host.append(bugC);
      }
      return;
    }
    if (occupied) {
      var doing = el(doc, "span", "cd-ckb", COPY.cardDoing);
      doing.style.color = "#2b62b0"; // --cd-mark-doing
      host.append(doing);
      return;
    }
    if (hasBug) {
      var bug = el(doc, "span", "cd-corner", COPY.cardBug);
      bug.style.color = "#d73a4a"; // --cd-mark-bug
      host.append(bug);
      return;
    }
    var ready = el(doc, "span", "cd-ckj", COPY.cardPickReady);
    ready.style.color = "#10b981"; // --cd-mark-ready
    host.append(ready);
  }

  function renderRow(doc, row, ctx) {
    var closed = row.state === "closed";
    var occupied = !closed && (isClaimed(row) || isBlocked(row));
    var cls = "ms-row ms-kind-" + (row.type || "issue") + " " + (closed ? "ms-closed" : "ms-open");
    if (isClaimed(row)) cls += " ms-claimed";
    if (isBlocked(row)) cls += " ms-blocked";
    var r = el(doc, "div", cls);
    r.setAttribute("data-num", numberText(row));

    // 图钉(PixelCardPin):closed 票胶带,open 票圆图钉 #c0392b
    if (closed) {
      r.append(el(doc, "span", "cd-pin-tape"));
    } else {
      var pin = el(doc, "span", "cd-pin");
      pin.style.background = "#c0392b";
      r.append(pin);
    }

    var isContainer = row.type === "map" || row.type === "spec";
    var hex = isContainer
      ? ((Cards.containerNumberColor || function () { return "#8b5cf6"; })(
          row.type,
          (Cards.containerStateOf || function () { return "open"; })((ctx.containerStats || {})[row.effortId])
        )).slice(1)
      : actionHexOf(row);
    r.setAttribute("data-cd-act", "#" + hex);
    if (isContainer) {
      // 容器行身份色:左边框 accent + 底色 tint(container-view)
      r.style.borderLeft = "3px solid " + ((Cards.CONTAINER_ACCENT || {})[row.type] || "");
      r.style.background = (Cards.CONTAINER_TINT || {})[row.type] || "";
    }

    var head = el(doc, "div", "ms-row-head");
    appendCornerMark(doc, head, row, occupied);
    appendBadge(doc, head, row, hex);
    if (closed) {
      // 结案章(PixelClosedSeal):#a3231a 底 #fff9ec 字
      var seal = el(doc, "span", "cd-sealcn", COPY.cardClosedSeal);
      seal.style.background = "#a3231a";
      seal.style.color = "#fff9ec";
      head.append(seal);
    }
    var title = el(doc, "span", "ms-title", row.title || "");
    title.setAttribute("title", row.title || "");
    head.append(title);
    head.append(el(doc, "span", "ms-state-chip", closed ? COPY.stateClosed : COPY.stateOpen));
    r.append(head);

    // 红色脚注(PixelCardNote):被 open 阻塞时「被 {n} 挡住」
    var blockers = openBlockerCount(row);
    if (blockers > 0 && !closed) {
      r.append(el(doc, "div", "cd-note", COPY.cardBlockedBy.replace("{n}", String(blockers))));
    }

    var foot = el(doc, "div", "ms-row-foot");
    var tags = el(doc, "div", "ms-tags");
    var labels = Array.isArray(row.labels) ? row.labels : [];
    for (var lab of labels) {
      if (!lab || !lab.name) continue;
      var lhex = labelColorOf(lab.name);
      var chip = el(doc, "span", "ms-label cd-lb");
      var dot = el(doc, "span", "ms-label-dot");
      dot.setAttribute("data-color", "#" + lhex);
      dot.style.background = "#" + lhex;
      chip.append(dot);
      chip.append(lab.name);
      // 标签墨块(PixelCardTags):真实标签色实心底 + cardInkOn 字色 + 罩纱标记;边 = darken(色,.16)
      chip.style.background = "#" + lhex;
      chip.style.color = Cards.cardInkOn ? Cards.cardInkOn(lhex) : "#1c1004";
      chip.style.borderColor = Cards.darkenHex ? Cards.darkenHex(lhex, 0.16) : "";
      if (Cards.cardBoostOn && Cards.cardBoostOn(lhex)) chip.setAttribute("data-cd-boost", "1");
      tags.append(chip);
    }
    foot.append(tags);
    var marks = el(doc, "div", "ms-marks");
    if (isClaimed(row)) marks.append(el(doc, "span", "ms-mark ms-mark-claimed", COPY.markClaimed));
    if (isBlocked(row)) marks.append(el(doc, "span", "ms-mark ms-mark-blocked", COPY.markBlocked));
    foot.append(marks);
    r.append(foot);
    return r;
  }
  // ---- 看板视图状态(工单 04):筛选/排序/标签点击记忆/关闭票折叠,内存态 ----
  var view = {
    state: "all", // all | open | closed | blocked | frontier(list-page.md 状态组)
    sortKey: "number", // updatedAt | createdAt | number | title;默认档「编号升序」
    sortDir: 1,
    labels: [], // 标签多选 OR
    clicks: {}, // 标签点击记忆 {name:{n,ts}}
    labelsOpen: false, // 标签组展开
    closedOpen: false, // 关闭票折叠区展开
  };
  var boardData = null; // 最近一次成功加载的 {rows, counts},筛选变化时原地重渲染

  function rerender(doc, root) {
    if (!boardData) return;
    renderBoard(doc, root, boardData.rows, boardData.counts, view);
  }

  /** 筛选行(listFilterRow.md:list-page.md §2):状态紫/排序蓝/标签真实色三组墨块。 */
  function renderFilterRow(doc, rows, view) {
    var bar = el(doc, "div", "ms-filter");
    var STATE_KEYS = [
      ["all", COPY.filterAll], ["open", COPY.filterOpen], ["closed", COPY.filterClosed],
      ["blocked", COPY.filterBlocked], ["frontier", COPY.filterFrontier],
    ];
    var SORT_KEYS = [
      ["updatedAt", COPY.sortUpdatedAt], ["createdAt", COPY.sortCreatedAt],
      ["number", COPY.sortNumber], ["title", COPY.sortTitle],
    ];
    var sep = function () {
      return el(doc, "i", "ms-filter-sep");
    };

    // 状态组(单选):选中墨块紫(rgba(188,140,255,.18)/.6 边,#c084fc 字 = CONTAINER_ACCENT.map)
    STATE_KEYS.forEach(function (pair, i) {
      var chip = el(doc, "span", "ms-chip ms-chip-state" + (view.state === pair[0] ? " is-on" : ""), pair[1]);
      chip.setAttribute("data-state", pair[0]);
      if (view.state === pair[0]) {
        chip.style.color = (Cards.CONTAINER_ACCENT || {}).map || "#c084fc";
        chip.style.background = "rgba(188,140,255,.18)";
        chip.style.borderColor = "rgba(188,140,255,.6)";
      }
      chip.addEventListener("click", function () {
        view.state = pair[0];
        rerender(doc, doc.getElementById("root"));
      });
      bar.append(chip);
      if (i === STATE_KEYS.length - 1) bar.append(sep());
    });

    // 排序组(单选+翻转):点同键翻转 asc/desc;换键时 title 默认 asc、其余 desc
    SORT_KEYS.forEach(function (pair, i) {
      var on = view.sortKey === pair[0];
      var chip = el(doc, "span", "ms-chip ms-chip-sort" + (on ? " is-on" : ""),
        pair[1] + (on ? (view.sortDir === 1 ? " ↑" : " ↓") : ""));
      chip.setAttribute("data-sort", pair[0]);
      if (on) {
        chip.style.color = "#58a6ff";
        chip.style.background = "rgba(88,166,255,.16)";
        chip.style.borderColor = "rgba(88,166,255,.55)";
      }
      chip.addEventListener("click", function () {
        if (view.sortKey === pair[0]) view.sortDir = -view.sortDir;
        else {
          view.sortKey = pair[0];
          view.sortDir = pair[0] === "title" ? 1 : -1;
        }
        rerender(doc, doc.getElementById("root"));
      });
      bar.append(chip);
      if (i === SORT_KEYS.length - 1) bar.append(sep());
    });

    // 标签组(多选 OR):全部恒清空;普通标签真实色;默认 4 颗,+N 展开/收起
    var allChip = el(doc, "span", "ms-chip ms-chip-label ms-chip-all" + (view.labels.length === 0 ? " is-on" : ""), COPY.filterLabelAll);
    allChip.setAttribute("data-label", "");
    if (view.labels.length === 0) {
      allChip.style.background = "rgba(255,255,255,.08)";
      allChip.style.borderColor = "rgba(255,255,255,.65)";
    }
    allChip.addEventListener("click", function () {
      view.labels = [];
      rerender(doc, doc.getElementById("root"));
    });
    bar.append(allChip);

    var catalog = Cards.labelCatalog ? Cards.labelCatalog(rows) : new Map();
    var sortedLabels = Cards.sortLabelChips ? Cards.sortLabelChips(catalog, view.clicks) : [];
    var shown = view.labelsOpen ? sortedLabels : sortedLabels.slice(0, 4);
    shown.forEach(function (item) {
      var hex = labelColorOf(item.name);
      var known = !!LABEL_COLORS[item.name];
      var on = view.labels.indexOf(item.name) >= 0;
      var chip = el(doc, "span", "ms-chip ms-chip-label" + (on ? " is-on" : ""), item.name);
      chip.setAttribute("data-label", item.name);
      chip.style.color = known ? "#" + hex : "#bc8cff";
      chip.style.background = Cards.hexA ? Cards.hexA(hex, 0.18) : "";
      chip.style.borderColor = Cards.darkenHex ? Cards.darkenHex(hex, 0.16) : "";
      chip.addEventListener("click", function () {
        var at = view.labels.indexOf(item.name);
        if (at >= 0) view.labels.splice(at, 1);
        else view.labels.push(item.name);
        var mem = view.clicks[item.name] || (view.clicks[item.name] = { n: 0, ts: 0 });
        mem.n += 1;
        mem.ts = Date.now();
        rerender(doc, doc.getElementById("root"));
      });
      bar.append(chip);
    });
    if (sortedLabels.length > 4) {
      var more = el(doc, "span", "ms-chip ms-chip-more", view.labelsOpen ? COPY.filterCollapse : "+" + (sortedLabels.length - 4));
      more.addEventListener("click", function () {
        view.labelsOpen = !view.labelsOpen;
        rerender(doc, doc.getElementById("root"));
      });
      bar.append(more);
    }
    return bar;
  }

  function renderBoard(doc, root, rows, counts, view) {
    var app = el(doc, "div", "ms-app ms-board");
    var head = el(doc, "div", "ms-head");
    head.append(el(doc, "span", "ms-head-title", COPY.boardTitle));
    app.append(head);
    app.append(renderCountsBar(doc, counts));
    app.append(renderFilterRow(doc, rows, view));

    var v = Cards.applyView ? Cards.applyView(rows, view) : { openRows: rows, closedRows: [] };
    var openRows = Cards.sortViewRows ? Cards.sortViewRows(v.openRows, view.sortKey, view.sortDir) : sortRows(v.openRows);
    var closedRows = Cards.sortViewRows ? Cards.sortViewRows(v.closedRows, view.sortKey, view.sortDir) : sortRows(v.closedRows);
    var visible = view.state === "closed" ? closedRows : openRows.concat(view.closedOpen ? closedRows : []);

    var list = el(doc, "div", "ms-rows");
    var ctx = { containerStats: containerStatsOf(rows) };
    for (var row of visible) list.append(renderRow(doc, row, ctx));
    app.append(list);
    if (visible.length === 0) app.append(el(doc, "div", "ms-none", COPY.listNone));
    if (view.state === "all" && closedRows.length > 0) {
      var fold = el(doc, "div", "ms-closed-fold" + (view.closedOpen ? " open" : ""),
        COPY.listClosedN.replace("{n}", String(closedRows.length)));
      if (view.closedOpen) fold.append(el(doc, "span", "ms-fold-arrow", "▾"));
      else fold.append(el(doc, "span", "ms-fold-arrow", "▸"));
      fold.addEventListener("click", function () {
        view.closedOpen = !view.closedOpen;
        rerender(doc, root);
      });
      app.append(fold);
    }
    root.replaceChildren(app);
  }

  // ---- 实时刷新(工单 08) ----
  // 可见时按 probeIntervalMs(5s,上游活跃探测口径)轮询 counts 的 revision,变化才重拉列表;
  // document 不可见即暂停(上游黄档 120s 依赖注意力信号,M1 无此信号,不引入)。
  var POLL_MS = 5000;
  var ctx = null; // 当前引导会话 {client, doc, root}
  var pollTimer = null;
  var lastRevision; // undefined = 未知(服务端没给 revision 就不自动刷新)
  var everLoaded = false; // 初始加载失败时轮询负责静默重试,成功过就只认 revision 信号
  var loading = false;
  var queued = false; // 载入途中又触发:结束后补一轮
  var visBound = false;

  /** 拉全套数据并渲染;silent 为真时不铺加载态、失败保留已渲染内容(轮询路径)。 */
  async function reload(opts) {
    var silent = opts && opts.silent;
    var c = ctx;
    if (!c) return;
    if (!silent) renderLoading(c.doc, c.root);
    if (loading) {
      queued = true;
      return;
    }
    loading = true;
    try {
      var results = await Promise.all([
        c.client.callTool("deck_issue_list", {}),
        c.client.callTool("deck_issue_counts", {}),
      ]);
      var list = results[0];
      var counts = results[1];
      if (list && list.isError) throw Error(textOf(list) || "deck_issue_list 失败");
      if (counts && counts.isError) throw Error(textOf(counts) || "deck_issue_counts 失败");
      var listSc = (list && list.structuredContent) || {};
      var countsSc = (counts && counts.structuredContent) || {};
      everLoaded = true;
      if (countsSc.revision !== undefined) lastRevision = countsSc.revision;
      if (countsSc.empty || listSc.empty) {
        renderGuide(c.doc, c.root);
        return;
      }
      boardData = {
        rows: Array.isArray(listSc.rows) ? listSc.rows : [],
        counts: countsSc.counts || {},
      };
      renderBoard(c.doc, c.root, boardData.rows, boardData.counts, view);
    } catch (e) {
      if (!silent) renderError(c.doc, c.root, e);
    } finally {
      loading = false;
      if (queued) {
        queued = false;
        reload({ silent: true });
      }
    }
  }

  /** 轮询一格:只打 counts,revision 变了才重拉列表。 */
  function tick() {
    var c = ctx;
    if (!c || loading) return;
    if (c.doc.hidden) return; // 不可见暂停,不空耗
    c.client
      .callTool("deck_issue_counts", {})
      .then(function (r) {
        if (!r || r.isError) return; // 失败静默,下轮再试
        var sc = (r && r.structuredContent) || {};
        if (lastRevision === undefined) {
          if (!everLoaded) reload({ silent: true }); // 初始加载失败过:轮询里静默重试
          return;
        }
        if (sc.revision !== undefined && sc.revision !== lastRevision) reload({ silent: true });
      })
      .catch(function () {});
  }

  // ---- 入口 ----
  async function boot(opts) {
    var client = opts.client;
    var doc = opts.doc;
    var root = opts.root;
    var pollMs = opts.pollMs === undefined ? POLL_MS : opts.pollMs;
    stopPolling(); // 重复引导(测试/宿主重挂)先撤旧节拍
    ctx = { client: client, doc: doc, root: root };
    lastRevision = undefined;
    everLoaded = false;
    if (!visBound && typeof doc.addEventListener === "function") {
      visBound = true;
      doc.addEventListener("visibilitychange", function () {
        if (!doc.hidden) tick(); // 转回可见立即补一格,不等下一拍
      });
    }
    if (pollMs > 0) pollTimer = setInterval(tick, pollMs);
    await reload({});
  }

  /** 强刷钩子:写操作/动作后立即重拉(revision 未变也拉;T06/T07 调)。 */
  function refresh() {
    return reload({ silent: true });
  }
  function stopPolling() {
    if (pollTimer) {
      clearInterval(pollTimer);
      pollTimer = null;
    }
  }

  window.MattSkillsPanel = { boot: boot, refresh: refresh, stopPolling: stopPolling };
})();
